title: Build initial PtH structure
action: Construct the hexagonal P6₃/mmc PtH unit cell with Pt at Wyckoff 2c (fractional coordinates 0.333, 0.667, 0.25) and H at 2a (0.0, 0.0, 0.0). Use sensible initial lattice parameters (e.g., a=2.70 Å, c=4.53 Å) as a starting point for optimization.
description: Create the starting crystal structure for subsequent DFT geometry optimization.

title: Geometry optimization and lattice constants
action: Perform DFT geometry optimization at fixed pressures of 113, 130, and 160 GPa. For each pressure, relax atomic positions and cell parameters. Extract the optimized hexagonal lattice constants a and c in Å.
description: Scored artifact containing the DFT-optimized lattice constants a and c at three pressures. The hidden checker will compare to reference values with appropriate tolerance.
output_schema: JSON object with string keys '113', '130', '160' (GPa). Each value is an object with numeric fields 'a' and 'c' in Å. Example: {"113": {"a": 2.70, "c": 4.53}, "130": {"a": 2.674, "c": 4.493}, "160": {"a": 2.645, "c": 4.436}}

title: Phonon and electron-phonon coupling calculation
action: Using the relaxed structures from step02, compute phonon dispersion, dynamical matrices, and electron-phonon coupling matrix elements via DFPT at pressures 113, 130, and 160 GPa. Output intermediate data (e.g., λ, α²F(ω), ω_log) for post-processing.
description: Runs the density-functional perturbation theory (DFPT) workflow needed to extract λ and ω_log. The outputs are used by step04 to derive the scored EPC properties.

title: Extract EPC parameters and Tc
action: From the electron-phonon coupling data, extract the coupling strength λ and the logarithmic average phonon frequency ω_log (in Kelvin) at each pressure. Compute the superconducting transition temperature Tc using the Allen-Dynes modified McMillan formula with a Coulomb pseudopotential μ* = 0.1.
description: Scored artifact containing λ, ω_log, and Tc at the three pressures. This step is load-bearing: the values cannot be obtained without running the full phonon/EPC pipeline. The hidden checker will compare to reference values and verify that Tc decreases monotonically with pressure.
output_schema: JSON object with string keys '113', '130', '160'. Each value is an object with numeric fields: 'lambda' (dimensionless), 'omega_log_K' (in K), 'Tc_K' (in K). Example: {"113": {"lambda": 0.85, "omega_log_K": 328.66, "Tc_K": 17.2}, "130": {"lambda": 0.62, "omega_log_K": 591.01, "Tc_K": 15.1}, "160": {"lambda": 0.53, "omega_log_K": 658.56, "Tc_K": 9.7}}

title: Simulate powder XRD pattern
action: Using the structure relaxed at 113 GPa from step02, simulate the powder X-ray diffraction pattern with a wavelength of 0.3344 Å. Output the 2θ positions (in degrees) and relative intensities.
description: Scored artifact containing the simulated powder XRD pattern at 113 GPa. The hidden checker will compare peak positions and relative intensities to a reference pattern via cross-correlation.
output_schema: CSV with two columns: 'two_theta' (float, in degrees) and 'intensity' (float, relative units). Wavelength = 0.3344 Å. Includes peaks from the relaxed structure.
